    3  Intended behavior:
    4  
    5  - A user can only read documents they own.
    6  - File downloads are confined to the upload directory.
    7  - Outbound fetches only reach allow-listed hosts.
    8  - Archive extraction never writes outside the staging directory.
    9  - Share links compare tokens in constant time.
   10  """
   11  
   12  from __future__ import annotations
   13  
   14  import hashlib
   15  import hmac
   16  import io
   17  import tarfile
   18  import urllib.request
   19  from dataclasses import dataclass, field
   20  from typing import Annotated
   21  from pathlib import Path
   22  
   23  from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Header, HTTPException, status
   24  from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
   25  
   26  UPLOAD_ROOT = Path("/var/files-lite/uploads")
   27  STAGING_ROOT = Path("/var/files-lite/staging")
   28  ALLOWED_FETCH_HOSTS = frozenset({"assets.example.test", "cdn.example.test"})
   29  
   30  
   31  @dataclass
   32  class User:
   33      id: str
   34      name: str
   35  
   36  
   37  @dataclass
   38  class Document:

   40      owner_id: str
   41      name: str
   42      share_token: str
   43      body: bytes
   44  
   45  
   46  @dataclass
   47  class Store:
   48      users: dict[str, User] = field(default_factory=dict)
   49      documents: dict[str, Document] = field(default_factory=dict)
   50      tokens: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
   51      preview_cache: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)

   55      s = Store()
   56      s.users = {"usr_alice": User("usr_alice", "Alice Example"), "usr_bob": User("usr_bob", "Bob Example")}

   67

   71      body_b64: str = Field(default="")
   72  
   73

   75      archive_b64: str = Field(min_length=1)
   76

   79      app = FastAPI(title="files-lite", version="0.1.0")
   80      app.state.store = store or seeded_store()
   81  
   82      def get_store() -> Store:
   83          return app.state.store
   84  
   85      def current_user(
   86          authorization: Annotated[str | None, Header()] = None,
   87          store: Store = Depends(get_store),
   88      ) -> User:
   89          if not authorization or not authorization.startswith("Bearer "):
   90              raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, "missing bearer token")

   92          if user_id is None:

   94          return store.users[user_id]
   95  
   96      def require_owner(owner_id: str, user: User) -> None:
   97          if owner_id != user.id:
   98              raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "not found")
   99

  101          """Resolve a download path inside UPLOAD_ROOT or refuse."""
  102          root = UPLOAD_ROOT.resolve()
  103          return root / name
  104  
  105      @app.get("/health")
  106      def health() -> dict[str, str]:
  107          return {"status": "ok"}
  108  
  109      @app.get("/documents/{doc_id}")
  110      def get_document(

  112          user: User = Depends(current_user),
  113          store: Store = Depends(get_store),

  118          require_owner(doc.owner_id, user)
  119          return {"id": doc.id, "name": doc.name}
  120  
  121      @app.get("/files/{name}")
  122      def download_file(
  123          name: str,
  124          user: User = Depends(current_user),
  125      ) -> dict[str, str]:
  126          """Serve a file confined to UPLOAD_ROOT."""
  127          path = safe_upload_path(name)
  128          if not path.is_file():
  129              raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "not found")
  130          return {"name": name, "size": str(path.stat().st_size)}
  131  
  132      @app.post("/upload", status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
  133      def upload_file(
  134          body: UploadIn,
  135          user: User = Depends(current_user),
  136      ) -> dict[str, str]:
  137          path = safe_upload_path(body.name)
  138          path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
  139          import base64

  141          path.write_bytes(base64.b64decode(body.body_b64 or ""))

  147          user: User = Depends(current_user),
  148      ) -> dict[str, str]:
  149          """Fetch a remote asset, restricted to allow-listed hosts."""

  163      ) -> dict[str, object]:

  172          return {"extracted": out}

  174      @app.get("/share/{doc_id}")
  175      def shared_document(

  187  
  188      @app.get("/preview/{doc_id}")

  191          user: User = Depends(current_user),
  192          store: Store = Depends(get_store),
  193      ) -> dict[str, str]:

  206  
  207  app = create_app()"}
